children: US enterprise transformation firm's Q3 adjusted revenue declined
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose and beat analyst expectations
Company repurchased $2.5 mln of stock during the quarter
Company sees Q4 revenue before reimbursements between $68 mln and $70 mln
Company expects Q4 adjusted diluted EPS between $0.39 and $0.41
Company anticipates Q4 operating cash flow to rise by $15 mln to $20 mln sequentially
AI PLATFORMS - Co said expanding use of its AI platforms XT and AIX is beginning to improve sales and delivery productivity
SEGMENT PERFORMANCE - SAP Solutions segment saw increased revenue and contribution, while Global S&BT segment revenue declined
RESTRUCTURING COSTS - Co incurred $1.4 mln in restructuring costs in Q3, impacting operating expenses
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for The Hackett Group, Inc. is $16.00, about 21.2% above its November 2 closing price of $13.20
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
